Aurora 14 Laptop

The Aurora 14 pairs a matte 2880×1800 display with a 70 Wh battery, which the manufacturer rates at fourteen hours of mixed office use per charge.

Ports are unusually generous for the size: two USB-C with charging support, one USB-A, HDMI 2.1 and a full-size SD reader on the right-hand edge.
